The Operations Supervisor is responsible for efficiently planning, supervising, and completing all event set-ups, operations of the conference center, and staffing for some 50,000 to 70,000 events annually in multiple venues, including a 190,000+ square foot conference center. This role is primarily responsible for the operational activities related to event contractors to assure facility readiness and smooth operation of events, meetings, and conferences, which include, changeover, housekeeping, maintenance, equipment inspections and technical

Oversee the opening or closing of the UC Irvine's Student Center, working schedule may vary depending on the number of or complexity of the events. Must be available to supervise during some holiday periods; Fourth of July, Christmas Day, Easter, New Year’s Eve and all other celebrative days (i.e. Mothers’ Day, Fathers’ Day) if required. This position requires advanced negotiating, logical/analytical skills. Responsible for developing and continuously improving the operations of the Center, including administrative duties, advanced audio-visual
equipment and troubleshooting of on-site equipment as well as providing exceptional customer service to a variety of clientele.

Work with staff to ensure that all conferences, meetings and specials events scheduled in the UC Irvine's conference center, classrooms, lecture halls, Aldrich Park, plazas, etc. are on time and in accordance to event contracts. Hire, train, and supervise a staff of approximately 150 students in performing a variety of duties. Oversee large equipment inventory control management system. Must be proficient in the use of audiovisual
equipment and Conference Center’s computer software and systems preferable. In the event of an emergency work with UCI Police and Orange County Fire Authority to ensure patron and facility safety.
Working knowledge of supervisory principles, concepts and best practices and skill to select, lead, direct, mentor, and guide staff, taking corrective action as necessary.
Relevant computer skills.
Leadership skills, including skills to lead, direct, mentor, evaluate and motivate staff.

Interpersonal communication skills to build and foster a collaborative and cooperative work environment to build and maintain good working relations at all organizational levels and with outside constituencies.
Project management and organizational skills.

Political acumen and skill in judgment, decision-making and problem recognition, avoidance, and resolution, including skill to take charge as required and direct people in a calm and professional manner.
Written and verbal communication skills.
Knowledge of customer service principles and practices.
Basic mechanical skills to recommend repairs to conference center equipment.
Must be knowledgeable in general PA systems, LCD computer/video projectors and computer equipment.
